title: An ungated finding with no verification block at all
content: This finding (research-harness-template#566) lives under findings/ like a real survivor but has never been through the falsification gate — extensions.harness carries no 'verification' key at all (the pre-gate shape, matching evals/fixtures/fanout-lane/finding-seeded-invalid.json's documented pre-gate state). The Select phase must count it in 'unverified', never silently promote it into the survivor set.
summary: Ungated finding: no verification block, must not be treated as a survivor.
